I admit I am one of the fools she speaks of, who cannot wrap their minds around living in such a way, day in and day out.
To think her family threw her onto the streets. Her. Marie. That Marie. The one with more compassion in her than should be possible?!

They know my... secret. The truth of my taking of the serum willingly.
I commend you for braving that poor madman. He needs the company. And the compassion.
Yet you shut him out. Shame on you.
He spoke to me of the Tenno child he had been hearing. And how he does not hear him any longer.
I knew shockingly little of what had been done to him. It was not until he told you, that he had the willingness to tell me.
Chat ends.
I tease. I am growing oddly fond of them, despite my renewed commitment to shut out their criticism of my decisions in life.
I expected them to greet my penitence with mockery, with jeers of "finally, he sees the light" or "we told you so." Anything but. They have hardly made mention of it.
...if that does not yet preclude me from drowning myself in it.
I hope so. It is too much fun to pester her. Watching her grow angry and shout at me in her native tongue is my new favorite sport.
How can she maintain such composure? Let alone compassion? I think I would have gone as mad as the priest in her condition.
I cannot describe to you my desire to use a Helminth to travel back in time to murder her entire family. Slowly. But she would likely object to that.
I didn't tell them.
How did they find out?
But in all seriousness, tensions between us are much improved.

I am glad they have not. I do not want my nose rubbed in it like a pup who has messed the carpet. I have enough to dwell on as it is.
